body.label: Effect
body.html: Choose one enemy within 4 units. On a success against Composure, make it Exposed.

surges.html: Choose another eligible creature; the target treats that creature as the source of this effect until the effect resolves.
After rolling, you may change this Action to another eligible target within 2 units of the original target.

rider.title: DIVERSION CONTINGENCY
rider.html: After resolving this Action, you may establish this Contingency. Trigger: The target consumes Exposed. Effect: Another enemy within 2 units becomes Exposed.
rider.meta: EXPIRES: START OF YOUR NEXT TURN
